newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Western Metals 3rd qtr zinc output down.
newsitem.headline: Western Metals 3rd qtr zinc output down.

text.p: Western Metals Ltd said on Thursday it produced 25,396 tonnes of zinc concentrates in the quarter ended March 31, down slightly from 25,540 tonnes recorded in the previous quarter.
Lead concentrate output over the same period increased to 7,345 tonnes from 6,795 tonnes, the company said.
Western Metals also said salvage work had continued to extend operations at its Cadjebut zinc mine in Western Australia, which was reaching the end of its mine life.
"It is now anticipated that mining at the present rates will be sustained into the September 1997 quarter before the reserves are mined to completion," the company said.
Zinc ore grades mined at its Goongewa deposit were 7.6 percent zinc per tonne in the March quarter, down from 9.3 percent in the previous quarter, the company said.
"Production from the high grade massive sulphide unit was limited this quarter by difficult ground conditions but availability will improve next month," the company said.
